mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its historical average compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship holds across monetary policy cycles without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation coefficient between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate to below 4.0% signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle, which compresses discount rates and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE) and decline in residential sales (RSAFS) signals a severe economic contraction, triggering a flight to safety that depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and RSAFS falls > 1.0% in the prior month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is negative over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a worsening economic outlook, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% and INDPRO falls > 0.5% in the prior month, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in the high-unemployment regime is negative over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1300 thousand units per month signals a severe housing market contraction, which triggers a negative feedback loop in consumer spending and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when HOUST < 1300, or the Rank IC between HOUST and 20-day returns is positive over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) relative to its 3-month moving average indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which depresses consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 5-day returns is positive over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP level (GDPC1) below 23000 billion dollars (in chained 2017 dollars) indicates a severe economic contraction, which triggers a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of quarters when GDPC1 < 23000, or the Rank IC between GDPC1 and 60-day returns is positive over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) indicates a severe housing market contraction, which amplifies consumer spending weakness and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST falls > 1.0% and RSAFS falls > 1.0% in the prior month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is negative over any 3-year window.
